::: {#sol-conv-shape}

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
conv = nn.Conv2d(1, 8, 3, padding=1)
conv_out = conv(x_train[:32])
print(conv_out.shape)
```

`conv_out` has [shape](pytorch-basics.qmd#def-shape) $32 \times 8 \times 8 \times 8$:
32 images,
each with 8 [channels](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/cnn-rnn.html#def-channel) of 8 rows and 8 columns.
With [padding](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/cnn-rnn.html#def-padding) 1 and [stride](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/cnn-rnn.html#def-stride) 1,
each side is $\floor{(8 + 2 - 3) / 1} + 1 = 8$ pixels long,
the same as the input's.
PyTorch orders the dimensions as images, channels, rows and columns [@pytorch_conv2d].

:::
